text: Philip Connell, a disgraced children's puppeteer, [returns to his fire-damaged childhood home in Norfolk|trigger|going back home], where his decrepit uncle Maurice still lives. He carries [a spider-like marionette called Possum|images|dolls, masks and likenesses] that comes back every time he tries to get rid of it, and a picture book he made as a boy shows it creeping on orphaned children in their beds. Maurice taunts him about bullying, a local boy goes missing, and Philip keeps circling [a closed room he says he will never enter|origin|harm done in childhood].
